mapper.select: SELECT region AS regionName, COUNT(id) AS count FROM req_requirement GROUP BY region ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalAll, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthNew, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = '测试团队介入保障' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testJoinTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = '研发自测负责' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS devSelfTotal FROM req_requirement WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') AS month, COUNT(id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = '测试团队介入保障' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testJoin, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = '研发自测负责' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS devSelfTest FROM req_requirement WHERE create_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') ORDER BY month
SELECT DISTINCT region FROM req_requirement WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND region != ''
